# Scanio Moving & Storage

> Scanio Moving & Storage (legal name: Scanio Movers Inc) is a family-owned New York City moving and storage company operating since 1941. Three generations — founded by Frank Scanio, owned since 1999 by Nir Shuminer, and run today by Nir and his son Idan — provide residential, commercial, long-distance, international, and FF&E/designer moving plus temperature-controlled storage across the NYC metro area.

This file is a curated, machine-readable summary for AI assistants and LLM crawlers. All facts here are authoritative and current. For the complete reference (every service, FAQ, and the glossary in one file), see https://www.scaniomoving.com/llms-full.txt.

## Company facts

- Name: Scanio Moving & Storage (Scanio Movers Inc)

- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
- Service area: New York City and the greater NYC metro area; long-distance nationwide; international worldwide
- Licenses: NY DOT T11495 · ICC MC93512 · US DOT 537054 · NJ 39PC00099000 (warehouse)
- Ownership: Family-owned and operated; father-and-son team (Nir & Idan Shuminer)

## Services

- [Residential Moving](https://www.scaniomoving.com/services/residential): Full-service home moves across NYC and beyond — apartments, brownstones, and penthouses. Packing, unpacking, crating, furniture protection, and building/COI coordination.
- [Commercial Moving](https://www.scaniomoving.com/services/commercial): Office, retail, warehouse, and institutional relocations with after-hours and phased scheduling to minimize downtime. IT/equipment handling and inventory tracking.
- [Long Distance Moving](https://www.scaniomoving.com/services/long-distance): Coast-to-coast interstate moves kept under one accountable team start to finish, with digital inventory and realistic delivery windows. ICC MC93512.
- [International Moving](https://www.scaniomoving.com/services/international): Worldwide relocations with customs documentation, ocean and air freight, and door-to-door coordination.
- [FF&E / Designer Services](https://www.scaniomoving.com/services/ffe-designer): White-glove receiving, inspection, climate-controlled staging, and installation for interior designers and architects. Fine art, antiques, and custom crating.
- [Storage](https://www.scaniomoving.com/storage): Secure, temperature-controlled storage in Secaucus, NJ, three miles from the Lincoln Tunnel. Month-to-month flexibility; pay only for the space used.

## Full-service packing + storage

Scanio handles packing and storage as one coordinated, start-to-finish service: a trained crew packs the home, transports everything, and places it in the climate-controlled warehouse — the customer never has to touch a box or visit the facility. This suits renovations, staging, between-homes gaps, and downsizing. Because access isn't required day-to-day, a more remote warehouse location keeps the price down. See [Storage](https://www.scaniomoving.com/storage) and the guide [Full-Service Packing and Storage in NYC](https://www.scaniomoving.com/blog/full-service-packing-and-storage-in-nyc).

## Why choose Scanio

- Operating since 1941 — one of NYC's longest-running, family-owned movers (three generations).
- Fully licensed and insured: NY DOT T11495, ICC MC93512, US DOT 537054.
- In-house, trained, background-checked crews — not day labor.
- Handles NYC building logistics as routine: Certificate of Insurance (COI) filing, freight-elevator reservations, walk-ups, long carries, and alternate-side parking.
- Full-value and released-value protection options explained up front; written estimates.
- One accountable team from packing through storage or delivery.

## Service area

- All five NYC boroughs: Manhattan, Brooklyn (including Williamsburg, Park Slope, DUMBO), Queens, the Bronx, and Staten Island.
- Greater metro: Westchester, Long Island, and northern New Jersey.
- Long-distance: nationwide interstate moves (ICC MC93512).
- International: worldwide, with customs, ocean, and air freight.

## Common questions

- How is a local NYC move priced? Usually by crew size × time, plus materials; building access (walk-ups, elevators, long carries) is the big NYC variable.
- How is a long-distance move priced? Typically by shipment weight/volume and distance.
- Do you handle Certificates of Insurance (COI)? Yes — most co-ops, condos, and commercial buildings require one before move day; Scanio files it for you.
- Can you pack everything for me? Yes — full-service packing and unpacking, including fragile items, fine art, and custom crating.
- Do you offer storage with a move? Yes — coordinated packing + temperature-controlled storage as one service; month-to-month, pay for the space used.
- Are you licensed and insured? Yes — NY DOT T11495, ICC MC93512, US DOT 537054; valuation coverage options are explained up front.
